prerequisites_now_present: CcRosTrimCache restored (#5630), dirty-VACB double-unmark/double-insertion race fixed (#9127), and low-memory balancer wait-under-AddressCreationLock assert fixed (#9467); all merged before the pinned baseline.
proposed_minimal_intervention: Compare the unmerged #9341 balancer logic against baseline ntoskrnl/mm/balance.c, specify a low-memory test matrix (512 MB, >RAM file copy, repeated consumer wakeups) and an observable pass-count criterion; no code change.
shared_root_cause: Cc/MM reclaim path (trim target, dirty-VACB bookkeeping and wait-under-lock) can stall or corrupt state under low memory; the same VACB lifecycle class appears in FS-V7-001 (fastfat copy corruption).
tests_performed: none; research-only directive, no build, boot, test, patch import or VM run
